newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close easier in holiday affected market.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close easier in holiday affected market.

text.p: * New Zealand shares ease slightly in quiet trading
* Leaders lose ground, Lion Nathan bucks trend
* Auckland and Australian holidays depress volumes
New Zealand shares eased slightly in quiet Monday trading made more tranquil by holidays in Auckland and Australia.
At the close the NZSE-40 capital index had dropped 7.02 to 2,393.25 as most leaders eased.
Brewer Lion Nathan went against the trend, rising three cents to NZ$3.63.
"The slow trading was probably the result of Auckland being on holiday and Australia Day had that market out of action," Patrick Lee of Christchurch brokers Lawrence Milton Howarth said.
"The fall in Wall St late last week meant investors were somewhat cautious heading into the new week and waiting to see the direction the Amercian market took."
The bid for Underground Fashions by Kimbyr at 33.5 NZ cents a share saw only 118,000 shares traded on market with the stock closing at 34 cents, up six cents.
"A typical quiet Monday accentuated by the Auckland and Australian holidays," Lee said.
